content.en_US:
2x2x2. A bigger HBM shredder that reads the same recipe table, with 15 inputs and 24 outputs instead of one of each.

All four blade slots must hold blades that are not worn out. One missing or fully worn blade stops the whole machine; half-worn blades still work. Every finished recipe adds 1 damage to all four blades at once.

The upgrade slot takes red speed plugins only: 40/30/27/20 ticks at 5,000 HE/t x (1 + level). It only runs if it can pay for the whole tick.

The even-split switch rearranges the 15 input slots every 20 ticks. Items that do not fit are dropped at the machine's feet, not eaten.

Output slots accept nothing - pipes can only pull from them.
content.zh_CN:
放大版的 HBM 粉碎机, 读同一张配方表, 输入输出从各 1 格扩到 15 进 24 出。

升级槽只收红色速度插件: 耗时 40/30/27/20 tick, 耗电 5,000 HE/t x (1+等级)。必须付得起整 tick 的电才会动。

均分开关开启后每 20 tick 重排 15 格输入。装不下的物品会掉在机器脚下, 不会被吞掉。

输出槽任何方式都放不进东西, 只能被管道抽走。
